newsitem.title: UK: Stakis buys its 52nd hotel for 7.8 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Stakis buys its 52nd hotel for 7.8 mln stg.

text.p: Stakis Plc, the Glasgow-based hotel, casino and health and leisure group, said on Tuesday it was buying a hotel and golf course in Gloucestershire for 7.8 million stg.
Stakis is buying the freehold property in Tewkesbury from Country Mansion Hotels Ltd.
After an extension in 1993, the four star Puckrup Hall Hotel, which will be known as the Stakis Tewkesbury, will have 84 rooms.
The hotel currently employs 163 staff, has conference and banqueting facilities for up to 530 delegates, a fully equipped health and leisure club and an 18 hole golf course.
Following completion, Stakis will have 52 hotels and 7,852 bedrooms.
